target.title: fix(skills): pass skill search limit through without pre-normalization
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Adds defensive test coverage for ClawHub skill and package search limit forwarding behavior. Ensures that configured limits are passed through verbatim to the ClawHub API, or omitted entirely when absent.

## Summary

- Added transport-layer tests for `searchClawHubSkills` and `searchClawHubPackages` limit forwarding
- Added lifecycle-layer tests for `searchClawHubSkills` limit handling
- Removed unsupported `999_999` package-limit assertion per ClawSweeper P2 finding
- Tests verify:
  - Valid limits forwarded unchanged
  - Omitted limits not added to URL

## Real behavior proof (live ClawHub API, 2026-07-19)

The exact code path under test (`src/infra/clawhub.ts` at head `84fa8e57`) was executed against the **real ClawHub API** (`https://clawhub.ai`, no token, no mocks). A logging `fetchImpl` wrapper recorded each outgoing request URL, then performed the real network call.

**Command** (run from the PR head worktree):

```bash
./node_modules/.bin/tsx live-proof.mts
```

**Observed live trace**:

```text
date: Sun Jul 19 2026 06:55:45 GMT+0800 (中国标准时间)
node: v24.18.0
code path: src/infra/clawhub.ts @ fix/clawhub-search-limit-cap (84fa8e57)
[skills explicit limit=5] request: GET https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/search?q=calendar&limit=5
[skills explicit limit=5] response: status=200 in 1943ms
[skills explicit limit=5] results=5
[skills omitted limit] request: GET https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/search?q=calendar
[skills omitted limit] response: status=200 in 1554ms
[skills omitted limit] results=10
[packages explicit limit=5] request: GET https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/packages/search?q=security&limit=5
[packages explicit limit=5] response: status=200 in 1530ms
[packages explicit limit=5] results=5
[packages omitted limit] request: GET https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/packages/search?q=security
[packages omitted limit] response: status=200 in 1556ms
[packages omitted limit] results=20
```

**What the trace proves**:

- Explicit supported limit (`limit=5`) is forwarded **unchanged** in the URL for both skill search (`/api/v1/search`) and package search (`/api/v1/packages/search`), and the real API honors it (exactly 5 results).
- Omitted limit produces **no `limit` query param** at all, and the real API applies its own defaults (10 skills / 20 packages).
- All requests returned `status=200` from the live service; nothing was mocked beyond wrapping `fetch` to log the URL.

## Regression tests

```bash
pnpm test src/infra/clawhub.test.ts src/skills/lifecycle/clawhub.test.ts --run
```

```text
✓ |unit| src/skills/lifecycle/clawhub.test.ts (77 tests)
✓ |infra| src/infra/clawhub.test.ts (86 tests)
Test Files  2 passed (2)
     Tests  163 passed (163)
```

## What was not tested

- Authenticated requests (token path) — public unauthenticated contract only; no credentials involved, nothing to redact.
- CLI layer end-to-end — the proof targets the exact transport functions that build the request URL, which is where the forwarding contract lives.
